entitySets: seven persona actors per organization with distinct synthetic subject IDs
one AP process and one intentionally incomplete process per workspace
one Assess V1 boundary fixture and one Assess V2 draft/review/approval chain per workspace
one application portfolio, modernization disposition, and governed Studio handoff per workspace
one private artifact aggregate with revision, approval, rendition, hold, and deletion-negative paths per workspace
one Delivery package with canonical work items and one Monitor baseline per workspace
one provider configuration per provider per organization using opaque local secret references only
one Trust evidence claim/publication lifecycle and one Pilot Operations candidate per workspace
dataRules: No customer, employee, PHI, credential, provider response, or copied live-system content.
Identifiers are deterministic synthetic UUIDs and never production identifiers.
Server authorization is asserted before resource existence or receipt disclosure.
Cleanup removes disposable runtime state but never rewrites retained acceptance evidence.
